task.title: Selecting a special condition for the decision on file

step.cmd: Determine which special condition options are displayed:

ul.li: If multiple options are displayed, go to step 12.
If No Decision Matches the ROE is the only option displayed, go to step 18.

step.cmd: In NWS, determine if there is a ROD on file for the period of employment:

ul.li: If yes, go to step 13.
If no , go to step 18.

step.cmd: Review the decision indicated in the ROD:

ul.li: If the ROD indicates that adjudication was deferred, go to step 14.
If the ROD does not indicate that adjudication was deferred, go to step 15.

step.cmd: In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ROE RFS Action WI, complete the Resolve Issue section as follows:

ul.li: Select the Special Condition for the decision on file: Select Adjudication Deferred .
Go to step 21.

step.cmd: Review the decision indicated in the ROD:

ul.li: If the ROD indicates Dismissal — ROE confirmation required , go to step 16.
If the ROD does not indicate “Dismissal — ROE confirmation required”, go to step 17.

step.cmd: In RCM, review the ROE and determine if the comments on the ROE confirm the automated decision on file (i.e. the comments on the ROE indicate that the client was dismissed for unsuitability or did not pass the probationary period or was terminated during the probationary period):

ul.li: If the comments on the ROE do not confirm the automated decision, go to step 18.
If the comments on the ROE confirm the automated decision, go to step 19.

step.cmd: In RCM, review the ROE and determine if there is information which contradicts the decision on file (e.g. the decision on file has a different RFS than the ROE):

ul.li: If there is contradictory information regarding the RFS on the ROE, go to step 18.
If there is no contradictory information regarding the RFS on the ROE, go to step 20.

step.cmd: In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ROE RFS Action WI, complete the Resolve Issue section as follows:

ul.li: Select the Special Condition for the decision on file: Select No Decision Matches the ROE .
Go to step 21.

step.cmd: In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ROE RFS Action WI, complete the Resolve Issue section as follows:

ul.li: Select the Special Condition for the decision on file: Select Misconduct – Not Proven .
Go to step 21.

step.cmd: In NWS, on the Resolve Issue tab of the ROE RFS Action WI, complete the Resolve Issue section as follows:

ul.li:
Select the Special Condition for the decision on file: Select the option that matches the decision in the ROD.
If the decision indicates Suspension from employment (D-42) , select Suspension .
If the decision indicates Anticipated Loss of Employment (D-44) , select Anticipated Loss of Employment and enter the disentitlement dates from the decision.
Go to step 21.
